summary: The request was a status query about a standing order, apparently about a monthly rent payment that the desk couldn't see for this cycle. The desk classified it as a standing-order status question and asked the recurring-payments system about it, which was the only action taken. The system's answer isn't in the case, so the attempted reply to the customer was refused and nothing has been said about whether the payment was sent. What remains for a person is to pick up the case once the recurring-payments answer is available.
